body: Which version of InstantSearch are you using? This issue has been fixed in the version [2.7.5](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md#275-2018-05-28). In case your version is lower than this one could you try to update the version? Otherwise could you provide us a working example of the issue? It will help a lot to better understand the problem. Here is [a template](https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/create-instantsearch-app/tree/templates/instantsearch.js).
